rationale: None of the supported evidence patterns yields a safe, applicable change for this workflow. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT (experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508): every job already declares timeout-minutes: 10 with operational headroom; history runs complete in about 19-22 s and the workflow comment deliberately keeps a 10-minute bound because a cold apt-get fallback once took about 6 minutes against a 6-hour default. No job is unbound, and lowering the timeout risks failing the cold-dependency/slow-valid-run safety tests, so the optimization is already satisfied. P-LIT-FAIL-FAST (experiment:batch-scenario-three-run-4bb0552aeb09c242): the workflow has no strategy:matrix, so there are no remaining matrix jobs to cancel; not applicable. P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9): there is no dependency installation or lockfile in the common path (PyYAML ships on ubuntu-latest and the apt-get fallback is conditional and not a cacheable package-manager flow), so there is no measurable repeated dependency fetch to cache; not applicable. All existing checks and coverage are preserved; no change is made.
